_comment: US law firms, template mode (user's exact copy v2, 2026-08-26). TWO fixed templates, never mixed: default = 1A time-capture/billing-leakage for hourly-billing firms; variant 'pi' = 1B medical-records pitch, auto-selected when the firm's scraped pages read as personal-injury/contingency (PI firms do not bill hourly, so 1A to a PI firm marks the sender as uninformed). Variant routing = the `variants` feature in draft_emails.py, keyword match on raw_html. {salutation} renders 'Mr./Mrs. Surname' or the first name per the salutation contract; {name} is the firm. No em-dashes. Scope: vault/lead-outreach/targeting/us-law-firms-scope.md
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

Most firms invoice only around 88% of the work they actually do. Lawyers forget to log the quick calls, the emails, the ten-minute reviews. Over a year, that's real revenue quietly disappearing.

We're 4th-year engineering students at AUB who've built AI agents for marketing agencies, oil & gas companies, hotels, and F&B consultancies. Our agent reads each lawyer's calendar, email, and documents, reconstructs the unbilled time, and sends it for approval.

Open to a 20-minute Google Meet this week to see it live?

Best,
David Geha
osgdev.com

variants.name: pi
variants._note: 1B: personal-injury firms. Matched on contingency/PI markers in the firm's own pages.
